text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't apologize... ...I'm 
grateful for how hard you worked for me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...My 'friend' is saying it too. 'Don't 
worry about it,' she says...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
